body: clarity of Intention: The Foundation of Spiritual Life The foundation of spiritual life is clarity of intention. Do Ireally want to be Free, here and now? You have to decide, do Iwant to be Free? Once the intention is clear, the mind becomes focused. When the mind is focused there is one-poiniedness. When there is one-poiniedness, the Heart will guide you. It will indicate what needs to be left behind and what needs to be avoided. Clarity of intention reveals the Heart. When the Heart is revealed trust is found and intuition flowers. Then one starts to understand what it means to live in the unknown. Then you can know what it is to be blind, and see everywhere. 2 4
